items.title: UGC platforms are turning to AI to make game developers out of everyday players

items.title: Remix launches platform for anyone to build their own game on desktop, web or mobile
items.excerpt: Remix, a game-making platform used by about 1.5 million players and creators, launched desktop apps for Windows, Mac and Linux; creators describe the game they want and Remix's AI tools write the code, then host it with leaderboards and real-time multiplayer.

items.title: How Tripo P2.0 & Astra Work Together in Blender and Unity

items.title: AI 역설계 통한 게임 베끼기 극성, 개발 생태계가 무너진다
